comment: Scenes scripts/bench.mjs walks. Each becomes two page loads — one per
runtime — because requestAnimationFrame has a single cadence per document
and two panes animating together would report the page's fps rather than
either runtime's (bench/bench.ts explains it in full).
`--corpus <dir>` points the script at a directory holding a file of this
shape plus the rigs it names, for real-world skeletons that never enter

scenes.name: meshed rig animating
scenes.why: the deform tier working every frame — the cost this approach was doubted on

scenes.name: meshed rig animating (canvas2d)
scenes.why: the default backend, and the one real Safari struggles with

scenes.name: held pose
scenes.why: dirty-skip home ground: unchanged meshes reuse their raster, the reference redraws regardless

scenes.name: rigid rig animating
scenes.why: region attachments only — pure and one CSS matrix per slot on this side

scenes.name: 8 small players
scenes.why: independent players, under the browser's WebGL context cap

scenes.name: 20 small players
scenes.why: past the ~16-context cap: the reference needs one context per player, this package shares one
